paite: Huan TOUPA bawm Philistia mite gam ah kha sagih sung a-om hi.
heading: Thukhun Bawm Piakkikna
english: Yahweh’s ark was in the country of the Philistines seven months.

paite: Philistia mite'n, "TOUPA bawm bang i loh ding ua? A-omna ngei mah apaisak nawndan hon hilh dih ve ua," chi in asiampute leh aisan siamte asam uhi.
english: The Philistines called for the priests and the diviners, saying, “What shall we do with Yahweh’s ark? Show us how we should send it to its place.”

paite: Amau, "Israelte' Pathian bawm na paisak ding uleh leng avuak in paisak het kei un. Akiang ah tatlek kithoihna lan ngeingei un. Huchi in hihdam in na om ding uh. Huchi in bangziak a akhut nou a pan lakkhiak a om lou ahia chih na thei ding uh," achi uhi.
english: They said, “If you send away the ark of the God of Israel, don’t send it empty; but by all means return a trespass offering to him. Then you will be healed, and it will be known to you why his hand is not removed from you.”

paite: Huchi in amau, "Akiang a ka tatlekna thillat ding bang ahia?" achi uh. Amau, "Philistia hausate zah dangka-eng zaangtan lim nga leh dangka-eng sansim lim nga; na vek ua tung leh na hausate uh tung a leng hipi lah khat ahi ngal a.
english: Then they said, “What should the trespass offering be which we shall return to him?” They said, “Five golden tumors and five golden mice, for the number of the lords of the Philistines; for one plague was on you all, and on your lords.

paite: Huaiziak in na zaangtan lim uh leh na gam uh hihsetu sansim limte bawl un. Israelte' Pathian thupina pia un, huchi in akhut na tung uah, na pathiante uleh na gam uh tung ah azangsak nuam khamoh kei ding," achi uhi.
english: Therefore you shall make images of your tumors and images of your mice that mar the land; and you shall give glory to the God of Israel. Perhaps he will release his hand from you, from your gods, and from your land.

paite: Aigupta mite leh Pharaoh in lungsim akhauhsak bang un bangziak a na lungtang uh khauhsak na hi ua? Alak ua thillamdang ahih in mite paisak in apawtkhesak uh, hilou maw?
english: Why then do you harden your hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts? When he had worked wonderfully among them, didn’t they let the people go, and they departed?

paite: Huaiziak in tu in kangtalai thak sutuah unla, bawngpi nih anawi suk lai, hakkol po ngei lou toh; huai bawngpite kangtalai ah khih unla, anoute uh amau a pan inn ah hon pi un.
english: “Now therefore take and prepare yourselves a new cart and two milk cows on which there has come no yoke; and tie the cows to the cart, and bring their calves home from them;

paite: TOUPA bawm la unla, kangtalai ah koih unla; tatlek thoihna dia na lat uh dangka-eng thil pen singlem ah thun in asik a koih in, paisak unla, khah un.
english: and take Yahweh’s ark and lay it on the cart. Put the jewels of gold, which you return him for a trespass offering, in a box by its side; and send it away, that it may go.

paite: Huchi in gamgi lam pang lampi tawn in Beth-shemesh ah apai hiam en un, apaileh i tung ua thil hoih loutak amah hih ana hi dia; apai keileh ei hon gawtpa amah khut ana hi kei chih i thei ding ua, i tung ua hong om himhim lel ahi ding, achi uhi.
english: Behold, if it goes up by the way of its own border to Beth Shemesh, then he has done us this great evil; but if not, then we shall know that it is not his hand that struck us. It was a chance that happened to us.”

paite: Mite'n huchibang in ahih ua; bawngpi anawi suk lai nih api ua, kangtalai ah akhih ua, anoute uh bel inn lam ah akhum uhi.
english: The men did so, and took two milk cows and tied them to the cart, and shut up their calves at home.

paite: Sansim lim dangka-eng leh zaangtan lim koihna singlem toh kangtalai ah TOUPA bawm akoih uhi.
english: They put Yahweh’s ark on the cart, and the box with the golden mice and the images of their tumors.

paite: Bawngpite'n Beth-shemesh lam zuan in lampi azui vengveng ua; huchi in ham kawmkawm in lampi azui ua, taklam ah hiam, veilam ah hiam apial het kei uh. Philistia hausate'n Beth-shemesh gamgi pha in azui uhi.
english: The cows took the straight way by the way to Beth Shemesh. They went along the highway, lowing as they went, and didn’t turn away to the right hand or to the left; and the lords of the Philistines went after them to the border of Beth Shemesh.

paite: Beth-shemesh khomite'n phaizang ah buh ana la ua, adaktou ua, bawm amu ua, akipahpih mahmah uhi.
english: The people of Beth Shemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the valley; and they lifted up their eyes and saw the ark, and rejoiced to see it.

paite: Huai kangtalai Beth-shemesh a mi Joshua lou ah alut a, suangpi lian mahmah omna tak ah akhawita hi. Kangtalai sing a-ek ua, TOUPA kiang ah bawngpite halmang thillat in alan uhi.
english: The cart came into the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh, and stood there, where there was a great stone. Then they split the wood of the cart and offered up the cows for a burnt offering to Yahweh.

paite: Levi chite'n TOUPA bawm dangka-eng thil omna singlem toh alakhia ua, suangpi tung ah akoih uhi. Beth-shemesh khomite'n huai ni mah in halmang thillatte leh kithoihnate TOUPA kiang ah alan uhi.
english: The Levites took down Yahweh’s ark and the box that was with it, in which the jewels of gold were, and put them on the great stone; and the men of Beth Shemesh offered burnt offerings and sacrificed sacrifices the same day to Yahweh.

paite: Huai Philistia hausa ngate'n amuh nung un, huai ni mahmah in Ekron kholam ah apai nawnta uhi.
english: When the five lords of the Philistines had seen it, they returned to Ekron the same day.

paite: Philistia mite'n dangka-eng zaangtan lim TOUPA kiang a tatlek thoihna dia alat uh, Ashdod kho tuam a ding in khat, Gaza kho tuam a ding in khat, Ashkelon kho tuam a ding in khat, Gath kho tuam a ding in khat, Ekron kho tuam a ding in khat ahi.
english: These are the golden tumors which the Philistines returned for a trespass offering to Yahweh: for Ashdod one, for Gaza one, for Ashkelon one, for Gath one, for Ekron one;

paite: Dangka-eng sansim lim ahihleh kho tengteng kulh nei khua leh singtang lam khua leng sim vek a hausa ngate a Philistia mite kho zah ahi. TOUPA bawm angakna suangpi mahmah uh Beth-shemesh khomi Joshua lou ah tuni tan in a-om nilouh lai hi.
english: and the golden mice, according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords, both of fortified cities and of country villages, even to the great stone on which they set down Yahweh’s ark. That stone remains to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh.

paite: TOUPA bawm sung a-et ziak un Beth-shemesh khomite ama'n agawt a, alak ua mi sangnga-le-sawmsagih tak athat hi. TOUPA'N anak thah ziak in mite'n asuun uhi.
english: He struck of the men of Beth Shemesh, because they had looked into Yahweh’s ark, he struck fifty thousand seventy of the men. Then the people mourned, because Yahweh had struck the people with a great slaughter.

paite: Beth-shemesh khomite'n, hiai Pathian siangthou TOUPA ma ah kua adingh thei in ei a pan kua kiang ah ahia apaitouh ding? achi uh.
english: The men of Beth Shemesh said, “Who is able to stand before Yahweh, this holy God? To whom shall he go up from us?”

paite: Huchi in Kiriath-jearim khomite kiang ah, "Philistia mite'n TOUPA bawm ahong koih nawn ua, hong suk unla na kiang uah latou dih ua," chi a hilh ding in thupo mite asawlta uhi.
english: They sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kiriath Jearim, saying, “The Philistines have brought back Yahweh’s ark. Come down and bring it up to yourselves.”
